# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 7 tokens; Charts — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 20 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Z index — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f4f2ec);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #111816);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f4f2ec;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f4f2ec | #111816 | Page ground behind cards when the sky background is off or loading; also the reduced-motion fallback base. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #19221f | Cards, day cards, search field, popovers, map popup. All reading text sits on this or on `surface`. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #e9e6de | #0b100e | Wells inside cards: chart plot area, compare-table header row, skeletons. Use `ink` or `ink-muted` text here, not `ink-subtle`. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #1b2422);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #e9ede8);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #1b2422;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #1b2422 | #e9ede8 | Primary text and temperatures on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-soft`. |
| `--ink-muted` | #4d5855 | #aab3ae | Secondary text: admin region and country in suggestions, sunrise/sunset line, comfort explanation, units. On all three surfaces. |
| `--ink-subtle` | #66706c | #8c9691 | Tertiary text: footer credits, footer joke, timestamps, placeholder. On `surface` and `surface-raised` only (4.1:1 on `surface-sunken` in light — too low). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--scrim, rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.84));
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--scrim, rgba(17, 24, 22, 0.84));
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.84);
```

### Tokens (20)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--scrim` | rgba(244, 242, 236, 0.84) | rgba(17, 24, 22, 0.84) | Translucent panel laid over the animated sky behind the hero heading and the header, so text never sits on moving pixels. |
| `--line` | #dcd8ce | #2a3430 | Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control. |
| `--line-strong` | #857f73 | #6c7772 | Borders of inputs and quiet buttons; 3.5:1 or more on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes. |
| `--brand` | #1d5e58 | #74c3b6 | Lake teal. Primary button fill, links, active pin, map marker, hourly chart line. As text: on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `brand-soft`. |
| `--brand-soft` | #dcebe7 | #1e3934 | Selected suggestion row, hover on day cards, pinned-city chip ground. |
| `--accent` | #d99a1e | #e6b54a | Weekend sun. Fill of the weekend marker and the Sat/Sun day-card top rule. Never as text on light grounds. |
| `--comfort-good` | #1a6040 | #7fd1a0 | Comfort 70–100 badge fill. Always shown with the number and the word “Комфортно”. Differs from `comfort-poor` by 3.4:1 in lightness in both themes. |
| `--comfort-fair` | #f0c94f | #e8c45c | Comfort 40–69 badge fill, with the word “Терпимо”. Low contrast against the page by design: the badge always carries a `line-strong` hairline. |
| `--comfort-poor` | #f29a7e | #a83f2a | Comfort 0–39 badge fill, with the word “Некомфортно”. |
| `--danger` | #a63a24 | #f08a72 | Text and icon of a failed-request Notice. Calm, not alarming: never a full red fill. |
| `--focus` | #1d5e58 | #74c3b6 | Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 6:1 or more on every surface in both themes. |
| `--sky-day-top` | #a9cbe0 | #a9cbe0 | Animated background, clear day, top of the gradient. Same in both UI themes: the sky follows the place's sunrise/sunset, not the UI theme. |
| `--sky-day-bottom` | #e8eff0 | #e8eff0 | Clear day, bottom of the gradient. |
| `--sky-overcast-top` | #b4bdc1 | #b4bdc1 | Cloudy or rainy day, top of the gradient. |
| `--sky-overcast-bottom` | #dfe3e2 | #dfe3e2 | Cloudy or rainy day, bottom. |
| `--sky-night-top` | #0e1726 | #0e1726 | Night, top of the gradient. |
| `--sky-night-bottom` | #25344b | #25344b | Night, bottom of the gradient. |
| `--sky-cloud` | rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) | rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) | Drifting cloud shapes, day and night. |
| `--sky-rain` | rgba(76, 104, 122, 0.45) | rgba(76, 104, 122, 0.45) | Rain streaks. |
| `--sky-snow` | rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) | rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) | Snow particles. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 48px/52px "Golos Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 48px / 52px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Hero question above the search. Once per page. |
| `temp-xl` | `.temp-xl`, `--text-temp-xl` | 40px / 44px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Weekend headline temperature. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 24px / 30px | 600 | `sans` | Active place name, section titles. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 18px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Card titles. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Comfort explanation, notices, all running text. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Suggestion secondary line, sunrise/sunset, table cells. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.01em | 600 | `sans` | Weekday on day cards, badge words, button text at small size. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Footer credits, footer joke, map attribution. |
| `clock` | `.clock`, `--text-clock` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `mono` | Header live clock. Tabular, so digits do not jitter. |
| `data` | `.data`, `--text-data` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Precipitation, wind, UV figures on day cards and in the compare table. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Golos Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap inside badges. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between figures on a day card; chip padding. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Day card inner padding; suggestion row padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding on mobile; gap in the 7-day grid. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding on desktop; gap between page sections on mobile. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between page sections on desktop. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Hero top and bottom padding. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Hero top padding on desktop. |
